capability.displayName: Archon Native BMAD Workflow For Codex
capability.summary: Runs BMAD route-first planning through Archon commands and DAG workflows, with Codex as a thin slash launcher that preserves advisory MCP mention context.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Archon owns the BMAD workflow through .archon commands and workflows.
Codex slash command is only a thin launcher and artifact summarizer.
Forge outputs are drafts and do not grant install, verifier, or runtime authority.
Agentic Search, Graphify, and Context7 are represented as advisory evidence in v1.
Prompts with no MCP, one MCP, or multiple MCPs preserve requested MCP names as advisory route context without claiming live MCP configuration.
WebGL2 MCP mentions route to host.mcp.context7.webgl-fundamentals.docs with /websites/webglfundamentals as canonical Context7 source and https://webgl2fundamentals.org as caveat only.
Google Apps Script MCP mentions route to host.mcp.context7.google-apps-script.docs with Apps Script Context7 source IDs, REST API, and @google/clasp mcp refs as advisory evidence only.

OfficeJS MCP mentions route to host.mcp.context7.office-js-live.docs and live Office MCP mentions route to host.mcp.office-js.live without claiming office4ai install, Office Add-in install, certificate trust, OAuth, Microsoft Graph permissions, or document mutation proof.
Vendored upstream BMAD snapshots are preserved as advisory moduleAwareness route evidence without claiming skill installation, runtime grant, MCP config, hooks, agents, or tool restrictions.

toolClasses.corePurpose: File Search retrieves context for Agentic Search decisions.
toolClasses.toolDescription: Use File Search when local repo files, docs, configs, or workflow definitions are the right context source; do not use it for live remote docs or secrets.
toolClasses.triggerCondition: Use File Search when local files are likely authoritative for the user request.
toolClasses.negativeTriggerCondition: Do not use File Search for live remote docs or secrets.
toolClasses.authorityBoundary: Retrieved context is advisory only; it is not verifier input, not grant authority, and not Workspace authority.
toolClasses.evidenceBoundary: Record source refs only; retrieved context is not verifier input and not Workspace authority.

toolClasses.corePurpose: Skill Loading retrieves context for Agentic Search decisions.
toolClasses.toolDescription: Use Skill Loading when exact BMAD skill behavior or routing boundaries are needed; do not use it as runtime grant, verifier authority, or install proof.
toolClasses.triggerCondition: Use Skill Loading when installed skill text is likely authoritative for the workflow route.
toolClasses.negativeTriggerCondition: Do not use Skill Loading as runtime grant, verifier authority, or install proof.
toolClasses.authorityBoundary: Retrieved context is advisory only; it is not verifier input, not grant authority, and not Workspace authority.
toolClasses.evidenceBoundary: Record skill refs only; retrieved context is not verifier input and not Workspace authority.
toolClasses.toolRelationship: Load the route-relevant BMAD skill before database-query or shell when its safety contract affects tool use.

toolClasses.corePurpose: Database Query retrieves context for Agentic Search decisions.
toolClasses.toolDescription: Use Database Query only after structured DB evidence, secret boundaries, and sample-row rules are defined; do not use it for raw secrets or Forge authority.
toolClasses.triggerCondition: Use Database Query only when the workflow has a declared DB evidence fixture and secret boundary.
toolClasses.negativeTriggerCondition: Do not use Database Query for raw secrets, live sample rows, or Forge authority.
toolClasses.authorityBoundary: Retrieved context is advisory only; it is not verifier input, not grant authority, and not Workspace authority.
toolClasses.evidenceBoundary: Record set/unset credential signals only; retrieved context is not verifier input and not Workspace authority.

toolClasses.corePurpose: Web Search retrieves context for Agentic Search decisions.
toolClasses.toolDescription: Use Web Search when current remote documentation is required and local evidence is stale or absent; do not use it when local docs already prove the claim.
toolClasses.triggerCondition: Use Web Search when current external facts are necessary for the user request.
toolClasses.negativeTriggerCondition: Do not use Web Search when official local docs or MCP evidence already cover the claim.
toolClasses.authorityBoundary: Retrieved context is advisory only; it is not verifier input, not grant authority, and not Workspace authority.
toolClasses.evidenceBoundary: Record URLs and summaries only; retrieved context is not verifier input and not Workspace authority.

toolClasses.corePurpose: Memory retrieves context for Agentic Search decisions.
toolClasses.toolDescription: Use Memory when prior route-boundary lessons affect current BMAD planning; do not use it instead of cheap live verification.
toolClasses.triggerCondition: Use Memory for repo history or prior decisions that materially affect the route.
toolClasses.negativeTriggerCondition: Do not use Memory for facts that are cheap and necessary to verify live.
toolClasses.authorityBoundary: Retrieved context is advisory only; it is not verifier input, not grant authority, and not Workspace authority.
toolClasses.evidenceBoundary: Record memory refs outside Forge authority; retrieved context is not verifier input and not Workspace authority.

toolClasses.corePurpose: Shell retrieves context for Agentic Search decisions.
toolClasses.toolDescription: Use Shell for deterministic local inspection, CLI help, validation, and smoke tests; do not use it for mutating commands in planning lanes.
toolClasses.triggerCondition: Use Shell when current repo state or command output is needed for the route.
toolClasses.negativeTriggerCondition: Do not use Shell for mutating commands in planning lanes.
toolClasses.authorityBoundary: Retrieved context is advisory only; it is not verifier input, not grant authority, and not Workspace authority.
toolClasses.evidenceBoundary: Record command summaries only; retrieved context is not verifier input and not Workspace authority.
